{{nihongo|'''Izanami Shrine, Mima'''|伊射奈美神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

=== History ===
Its founding is unknown. It is one of the candidate shrines (Ronsha) for the Shikinaisha "Izanami Shrine, Mima District, Awa Province." Another Ronsha of the same shrine name is {{ill|Izanami Shrine|Q43594845|qid=Q43594845|lt=Izanami Shrine}} in {{ill|Anabuki-chō Mishima|ja|穴吹町三島|qid=Q28689958}} in the same city<ref>''{{ill|Kadokawa Nihon Chimei Daijiten|Q4093011|qid=Q4093011}} 36 Tokushima Prefecture'' (1986, ISBN 4040013603)</ref>.

=== Access ===
* About 5 minutes by car from {{ill|Awa-Handa Station|Q4829609|qid=Q4829609}} on the {{ill|Tokushima Line|Q899310|qid=Q899310}} of {{ill|Shikoku Railway Company|Q496531|qid=Q496531|lt=JR}}.
